normalization_scope: Per response, over evaluable predicted boxes; population std; crowd-ignored boxes excluded and zero; K<=1 or zero variance yields zero. Stop penalties remain raw and independent.
matching: same-class maximum-total-IoU one-to-one; strictly positive IoU; dummy unmatched assignments
matched_credit: matched IoU minus mean quality for the same GT over all eight responses, then response-local object z-score; not MCR leave-one-out marginal contribution
class_stop_credit: negative unmatched-GT fraction within the class, at its last actually generated box_end
eos_credit: negative missing-GT count from entirely absent classes divided by all evaluable GT, at an actually generated terminal EOS
initialization: same original-ID SFT adapter as global-reward baseline; never initialize from the RL baseline
